event_corrections.source: Slow-motion stretch. p1 score rises only at 1018.90 (+1650), 1037.33 (+1800), 1051.50 (+1950), 1061.23 (+2100), 1063.03 (+2250): each step is REN+1, so the REN never broke and every piece cleared. NEXT shifts at 1019.67, 1037.97, 1052.17, 1061.93 only, so there are 4 pieces and 4 singles for chain t 1019.67/1037.97/1052.17/1061.93. Overview fr/g1/w007b.png: one J placed and cleared by 1037.3, the next J cleared at 1051.5. The single at 1034.67 is a phantom.
As n20: no score jump between 1037.33 and 1051.50 except the one clear at 1051.50, which belongs to the J spawned at 1037.97 (fr/g1/w007b.png). Phantom.
As n20: T spawned 1052.17 and cleared one row at 1061.23 (+2100, REN banner, fr/g1/w007a.png). No other spawn or score jump before 1061.93. Phantom.

fr/g1/w007a.png 1060.6-1064.6: only single-row clears, at ~1061.3 (T) and ~1063.1 (the L out of hold after Z was held at 1062.07). No TETRIS banner and no 4-row clear; the score steps are REN singles (+2100, +2250). Phantom quad.

p2 score jumps at 1040.27 (+1800), 1048.87 (+1950) and 1060.63 (+2100) only: REN singles. NEXT shifts at 1040.90 and 1049.47, so the Z spawned at 1040.90 cleared at 1048.87 (chain t 1040.9), and the next piece is chain t 1049.47. Single at 1048.43 is a duplicate.

Heavy slow motion 1410-1427. Spawns (NEXT shifts) at 1409.93 (I, cleared at 1415.93) and 1416.57 (O, slowly placed, its single scored at 1427.37), then 1428.00. Only two score jumps between 1409.57 and 1429.70 (+1650, +1800). The chain's 4 singles at 1409.97/1415.47/1416.67/1423.43 should be 2 (keep 1409.97 = I, 1416.67 = O). Phantom.
As above: no spawn between 1416.57 and 1428.00 and no score change between 1415.93 and 1427.37 other than the O's single. Phantom.

p2 NEXT shifts at 1408.53 and then not until 1428.57 (hold at 1422.30). p2 score flat at 22969 from 1407.90 to 1427.87, then +1950 at 1427.93: one piece, one single. Chain has singles at 1408.53 and 1408.63; 1408.63 is a duplicate.

fr/g1/w008.png: the S spawned 1178.10 and was held at 1178.30. The T from hold was hard-dropped upright into the garbage hole (+28 drop at 1178.50) and cleared one garbage row (white row flash 1178.57-1178.83). Score +1650 at 1178.53, a REN single. No T-SPIN banner; the TETRIS banner was still showing from the quad. That single breaks B2B, which explains why the TSD at 1182.47 scores +3607, not B2B.

Score: +~4800 at ~2557.2 (TST, Triple banner, 3 white rows 2557.1-2557.5 in fr/g1/w021.png), then +20 drop at 2558.10 with no clear, then +5410 at 2559.17 (TSD B2B) and +3600 at 2560.40 (quad B2B). The O spawned 2557.9 and locked 2558.1 with no clear; that is chain t 2558.03. The TST is chain 2556.57; the TSD is the T out of hold after the I was held at 2558.27 (chain 2558.13). Item n35's banner at 2557.27 is that same TST.

fr/g1/w026.png: an I was dropped into the left well at 2975.23 and cleared 4 garbage rows, with a TETRIS banner from 2975.77. Score +24 drop, then +2400 at 2975.27. fr/g1/w026b.png 2973.4-2974.9 shows no T-spin before it.

cell_edits.source: 4 phantom events removed (1034.67, 1046.73, 1060.2, 1061.7). Spawn count and the unbroken REN show 4 pieces in 1019.67-1061.93, where the chain had 8.
Duplicate single at 1048.43 removed (spawns at 1040.90 and 1049.47 only).
Phantom singles at 1415.47 and 1423.43 removed (spawns at 1409.93 and 1416.57 only in that span).
The REN ran unbroken through the gap: banners 10 REN at 1427.5 and 14 REN at 1432.7 (fr/g1/w010ren.png), +150 per score step. It ended before the double at 1435.13 (+919, no REN bonus).
Duplicate single at 1408.63 removed: only one piece between spawns 1408.53 and 1428.57.
Banner 11 REN at 1428.1 and 19 REN at 1436.0 (fr/g1/w010ren2.png). p2 score steps rise by +150 from 1427.93 to 1435.13, then the triple at 1435.83 (+4374 = 1500 + 150x19).
fr/g1/w022ko.png: an I spawned at 2618.20 was hard-dropped and locked flat on the left at 2618.33 (drop streaks), with no clear, before the KO at 2618.40. The chain's last event is 2617.6.

no_change.why: Covered by n20: the 1037.97 single is real (J cleared at 1051.50). The only fix in 1037.97-1052.17 is removing 1046.73, listed under n21.
p2 1049.47-1061.3: the T spawned at 1049.47 (held at 1055.27) cleared at 1060.63 (+2100). The O at 1061.30, held for the T, cleared at 1061.80. Chain 1049.47 and 1061.3 singles match.
w008 p2: lock +30 at 1190.73, then the next piece was soft-dropping (+1 per frame) until 1191.27 with no hard drop or lock by the KO at 1191.23.
w012 p2 fr/g1/w012ko.png: the Z spawned at 1833.37 and was held at 1833.60; the J from hold was still at the top at the KO (1833.87). No lock.
w015 p2: lock at 2131.87 (+18), then one soft-drop point at 2132.00 and a flat score through the KO. No lock.
fr/g1/w017tss.png: the T was hard-dropped (+16) into the left column and cleared one row with no T-SPIN banner (TETRIS banner left over, plus REN). Score +1050. The chain already has it as a single.
w017 p1: the 2286.0 piece locked at 2286.13 (+26). The piece spawned at 2286.24 was still soft-dropping at the KO (2286.67).
The TST banner at 2557.27 belongs to the TST already logged at chain t 2556.57 (3 rows cleared at ~2557.1). Nothing to add. The duplicate tst at 2558.03 is fixed under n34.
w023 p1 fr/g1/w023ko.png: lock at 2662.00 (+28). The Z spawned at 2662.10 hung in mid-air, unlocked, until the KO at 2662.93.

The jump at 3038.70-73 (+36 drop, +1800) is a zero-line Mini T-SPIN: banner 'Mini T-SPIN', top rows unchanged (fr/g1/w027b.png). It is the chain's None lock at 3038.5, so no clear was missed. A later +34/+1950 at 3039.47-53, just before the KO, could not be resolved from the frames (no queue shift; the J at the top did not visibly clear a row), so no correction is made for it.
